name: Sumino Nadeshiko
source:
The protagonist's older sister, a genius who can handle anything without effort.

She is a cool and calm person who strictly tells her brother what to do, but at the same time she takes care of him and cares for him. 

Although it seems she treats her brother like a child, in fact she secretly loves him a lot.

[Translated from [url=http://www.ole-m.net/products/saimin_wonderful/character_b.html#character_b]official website[/url]]
